parsed.rationale: Both `WidgetGetSnapshot` and `WidgetGetTimeline` are `type-alias-object` declarations in the same file (`Shared/Analytics/Sources/Analytics/Events/UIEvents.swift`) within the `Analytics` package. Although the structural signal reports them as exact duplicates with `shared_field_count: 1`, they represent distinct widget lifecycle events (snapshot vs. timeline) whose names encode different domain semantics. The structural similarity is purely coincidental — both are empty-body type aliases that happen to share the same shape — and collapsing them would erase meaningful event-type distinctions in the analytics event taxonomy.
